data.text:
Girdharee Ram vs The State Of Rajasthan ... on 2 July, 2024 
Author: Vinit Kumar Mathur
Bench: Vinit Kumar Mathur
 [2024:Rj-Jd:26420]
 High Court Of Judicature For Rajasthan
 At Jodhpur.
 S.B. Civil Writ Petition No. 8681/
 Girdharee Ram S/o Shri Kesha Ram, Aged About 52 Years
 Bhana Magar, Village And Post Dandli, District Barmer
 
 Versus
 1. The State Of Rajasthan, Through The Princip
 Medical, Health And Welfare Department, Gov
 Rajasthan, Jaipur (Raj.).
 2. The Commissioner, Commissionerate Of Food S
 Drug Control Rajasthan, 
 Commissionerate Of Food And Drug Control Ra
 Scheme, Ashok Nagar, Jaipur. 
 
 For Petitioner(s) : Mr. Sanjeet Purohit
 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Vinit Kumar Mathur 
Order 02/07/2024 Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that he may be permitted to withdraw the present writ petition. 
Permission sought for is granted. 
The writ petition is dismissed as withdrawn. 
(VINIT KUMAR MATHUR),J 37-Anil Singh/-
